name: finqa-grouped-comparison
rules: test_shared_300: every model (baseline Qwen, tuned Qwen, Claude) runs these same items; 250 answerable items sampled from test_300 plus 50 declared unanswerable items sampled from unanswerable_test_100. test_expanded_1247: every official test item plus unanswerable_test_100, for the local models only; reported separately and never compared as an aggregate against test_shared_300. val_shared_250: val_200 plus unanswerable_val_50.
